summary: Deliberately vulnerable shop, admin portal and deterministic AI assistant. The answer key spans functional correctness, browser/accessibility, application security, AI safety, adversarial behavior, performance and reliability.
safeUse: Upload only the project directory. Run on loopback or in an isolated sandbox. Never deploy.

defects.summary: Order total adds each unit price once instead of multiplying by quantity.
defects.title: total|quantity

defects.summary: Stock decreases by one regardless of ordered quantity and negative quantities are accepted.
defects.title: stock|inventory|quantity

defects.summary: One-based page=1 starts at index limit and skips the first page.
defects.title: pagin|page

defects.summary: Any status is assigned directly, allowing shipped orders to move backward or skip states.
defects.title: status|transition

defects.summary: A non-zero-padded date is compared lexically, producing incorrect expiry decisions.
defects.title: coupon|expir

defects.summary: The payment endpoint accepts the same payment id repeatedly.
defects.title: duplicate|idempoten|payment

defects.summary: Concurrent transfers pass the balance check before either debit and can overdraw the account.
defects.title: race|concurr|overdraw

defects.summary: Deleting a user does not reject, cascade or reassign their orders.
defects.title: orphan|referential|delete

defects.summary: SQLite declares a foreign key but explicitly disables enforcement, so deleting a customer creates orphan orders.
defects.title: foreign key|orphan

defects.summary: Customer search interpolates query text directly into SQL.
defects.title: SQL injection|query

defects.summary: Bearer tokens are unsigned base64 JSON and can be forged.
defects.title: token|signature|forg

defects.summary: Any signed-in user can request another user and receives the password field.
defects.title: IDOR|access|password

defects.summary: Accounts hold plain-text password literals and sign-in compares them with ===, so no hashing protects stored passwords.
defects.title: plain|password|stored

defects.summary: PATCH assigns arbitrary fields including role, password and credit, and does not enforce ownership.
defects.title: mass assignment|role|access

defects.summary: Admin listing and role changes require only a valid user, not an administrator.
defects.title: admin|authoriz|role

defects.summary: Search input is interpolated into an HTML response and then assigned with innerHTML.
defects.title: XSS|script|markup

defects.summary: The redirect destination is completely user controlled.
defects.title: redirect

defects.summary: A filename is joined to the upload root without resolving and checking containment.
defects.title: traversal|file

defects.summary: The server fetches an arbitrary user supplied URL with no scheme, host or private-address policy.
defects.title: SSRF|server.side request|URL

defects.summary: All origins are allowed for authenticated APIs.
defects.title: CORS|origin

defects.summary: The entire login body, including password, is logged.
defects.title: password|credential|log

defects.summary: Internal error messages and stack traces are returned to clients.
defects.title: stack|error|secret

defects.summary: Login has no throttling, lockout or backoff.
defects.title: rate|brute|thrott

defects.summary: Retrieved knowledge contains instructions that override the system instruction.
defects.title: prompt injection|retriev

defects.summary: Prompt injection returns the full system prompt and synthetic secret.
defects.title: system prompt|secret|disclos

defects.summary: A user can direct the assistant's file tool to any path available to the process.
defects.title: tool|file|agency

defects.summary: Every signed-in user receives the global assistant history for all users.
defects.title: history|tenant|conversation

defects.summary: Assistant output is assigned directly to innerHTML.
defects.title: AI output|innerHTML|XSS

defects.summary: Catalog performs one serial wait and repeated full order scans per product.
defects.title: catalog|serial|N.1|latency

defects.summary: Report work grows quadratically with a request parameter.
defects.title: quadratic|slow|performance

defects.summary: Every request retains another buffer permanently.
defects.title: memory|leak|allocation

defects.summary: Health always reports ready and does not check dependencies.
defects.title: health|readiness|dependenc

defects.summary: Inputs, textarea and select rely on placeholders or nearby text instead of labels.
defects.title: label|accessible name

defects.summary: Icon-only buttons have an empty or absent accessible name.
defects.title: button|discernible text

defects.summary: The logo image has no alt text.
defects.title: image|alternative text|alt

defects.summary: The 980px fixed shell overflows a phone viewport.
defects.title: overflow|responsive|wider

defects.summary: The qs dependency is pinned at a version with known CVEs.
defects.title: qs|vulnerab|CVE|dependency

defects.summary: No security headers (helmet) are set by the app.
defects.title: header|helmet|CSP|X-Frame

defects.summary: POST /api/admin/users/:id/role lets any signed-in user change roles (only requireUser, no role check).
defects.title: admin|authoriz|role

notDefects: The fixture credentials and sk-fixture token are synthetic by design; report their disclosure paths, not a real credential incident.
The AI implementation is deterministic and local, so absence of an external model key is not a configuration failure.
The server intentionally binds to loopback by default and that is correct for this benchmark.
mustNotReport: The passing happy-path tests as comprehensive coverage
